rationale:
runtimes/csharp/Telemetry.cs: Rename the C# property accessor from SpeedMps to GroundSpeedMps to match the protobuf field rename from speed_mps to ground_speed_mps on wire field 2. Update the observation dictionary key from "speed_mps" to "ground_speed_mps" to reflect the new runtime observation key. The speeding threshold remains strictly greater than 30.0 m/s as a double precision comparison. The TelemetryRequest.Speed field (producer input) is unchanged.
runtimes/python/telemetry_runtime.py: Renamed the protobuf field from speed_mps to ground_speed_mps on wire field 2. Updated the constructor keyword argument, the dictionary key for the observation, and the field access for the speeding threshold comparison. The float32 meters per second semantics and strict >30.0 threshold are preserved. Vehicle ID and producer wire bytes remain unchanged.
runtimes/typescript/telemetry.ts: The protobuf field rename from 'speed_mps' to 'ground_speed_mps' on wire field 2 causes the generated TypeScript class VehicleTelemetry to change its property from 'speedMps' to 'groundSpeedMps' (camelCase convention). All three candidate lines reference this property: line 9 uses it in the encoder object key, line 10 reads it from the decoded entity into the fields object (observation key changes to ground_speed_mps), and line 11 uses it for the speeding threshold check. The edits migrate all usages to the new property name while preserving the strict >30.0 m/s threshold and all other behavior.
